summary: Maxeon Solar Technologies, Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq delisting notice due to no independent board members on its Audit Committee and failure to file its Form 20-F for FY2025. The company is ineligible to submit a compliance plan and has a hearing scheduled for June 4, 2026 to appeal the delisting determination. Securities were suspended on May 1, 2026 and now trade over-the-counter. This filing confirms the delisting process rather than initiating a new event, with the hearing outcome as the key near-term catalyst.
